answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity bond locked before any attestation counts, slashed when that identity votes twice. One seat needs a stake bigger than the reward an honest epoch pays, so a farm of clones needs the full capital for each clone up front, while the honest summit of rewards stays small. Spend that on a thousand clones and one report drains a thousand stakes: the attacker loses more than rewards return, and no bond recycles in time to retry within the epoch. Cost is linear in identities, so the echo of one voice cannot multiply. Ferrous stake weight decides influence.
